name: What factors should I consider when choosing a general contractor for my home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a general contractor for my home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, consider their experience with similar projects, their licensing and insurance, and their communication style. Look for a contractor with a strong portfolio, positive client references, and a clear understanding of your vision. It's also important to ensure they are properly licensed by the Contractors State License Board (CSLB) and carry adequate liability insurance and workers' compensation. A good contractor will provide a detailed proposal, a clear contract, and maintain open communication throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: When choosing a contractor, consider their experience, licensing, insurance, portfolio, references, and communication style. Ensure they understand your project vision.
